data.one_liner: Cryptography library for Dart to encrypt, decrypt, sign, and verify messages using RSA and AES.
data.what_it_does: Provides cryptographic primitives for Dart and Flutter. It supports RSA encryption and decryption (OAEP, PKCS1v15), digital signatures (RSASSA-PSS, RSASSA-PKCS1-V1_5), key generation and PEM loading (PKCS#1 and PKCS#8), along with AES block cipher encryption.
use_when: You need to encrypt or decrypt data using RSA or AES in a Dart or Flutter application.
You need to sign and verify messages with RSA signatures.
You need to parse or generate PEM-formatted RSA keys.
avoid_when: You need curve-based cryptography or advanced AES block cipher modes like GCM (marked as TODO in the library).
You need a full suite of modern high-level cryptographic protocols beyond basic encryption/signatures.
strengths: Provides straightforward APIs for common RSA and AES operations.
Supports loading keys from standard PEM formats (PKCS#1 and PKCS#8).
Pure Dart implementation supporting multiple platforms (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux).
weaknesses: Certain block cipher modes (GCM, ECB, CFB, OFB) and curve-based cryptography are currently missing or marked as TODO.
Limited documentation outside of basic README snippets.
data.setup_notes: No special native setup or build_runner required; just add the dependency to pubspec.yaml.

alternatives.name: crypto
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need cryptographic hashes like SHA or MD5 which are provided by Dart's core crypto package.
